name: inline-pill-takeover
title: Inline Pill Takeover
description: A clipped pill expands inside a sentence, pushes the words apart, and takes over the frame.
useWhen: A sentence should turn an inline placeholder into a CTA without cutting to a separate title card.
The inserted label should push the surrounding copy apart before taking visual control.
avoidWhen: Only one phrase should change color without affecting layout: use inline-highlight.
The inserted copy should replace text rather than displace it: use caret-swap.
author: Remocn
